sources.summary: Earth Villa is part of Kaymana, a hospitality complex in Uluwatu, Bali, conceived around the ideas of solid flow, transition, and permanence. The architecture is rooted in the landscape: its solid, curved bamboo structure offers a steady rhythm, where the strength of bamboo harmonizes the vibrant flow of life with the unwavering power of the land.
